pillarOverview.title: AI & Large Language Model Solutions
pillarOverview.tagline: Practical, Grounded AI Designed to Solve Concrete Business Problems
pillarOverview.description: We help businesses evaluate, integrate, and operationalize artificial intelligence and Large Language Models. Rather than rushing to slap chatbots onto every product, we focus on grounded knowledge retrieval, document processing, intelligent internal workflows, and strict security safeguards.
pillarOverview.responsibleAiStatement: We believe responsible AI begins with clear boundaries: data minimization, prompt-injection defense, strict access controls, evaluation datasets, and human-in-the-loop approvals for consequential actions. We never claim any model is immune to hallucinations, and we design systems with explicit fallbacks and source citations.

services.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
services.shortDescription: Build AI knowledge assistants that answer questions using approved company documents, complete with source citations, access control, and fallback handling.
services.fullDescription: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds language models in your company’s actual, authorized documents. Rather than relying on a model’s training memory, our RAG architectures ingest approved documents, generate vector embeddings, retrieve the most relevant sections at query time, and synthesize answers with explicit citations. Crucially, when evidence is insufficient, our systems say "I don’t know" instead of inventing answers.
targetAudience: Companies with large technical documentation libraries or internal wikis
Customer support teams managing complex product manuals
Legal, HR, and compliance departments searching policy records
businessProblem: Standard LLMs hallucinate plausible-sounding but incorrect information when queried on internal company specifics.
Employees spend hours searching across fragmented PDFs, wikis, and tickets for critical procedures.
Fear that sensitive internal documents might leak across unauthorized user permission boundaries.
synezaSolution: Document ingestion pipelines with semantic chunking and metadata preservation.
Pre-retrieval access control: queries only search documents the authenticated user has permission to view.
Source-attributed responses: every claim links directly back to the source paragraph and document.
Explicit fallback threshold: if retrieval relevance is below confidence bounds, the system gracefully declines to answer.
keyCapabilities: Document parsing and ingestion (PDF, Markdown, HTML, DOCX, TXT)
Semantic chunking with overlapping context and metadata tagging
Vector embedding generation and semantic similarity search
Pre-retrieval authorization and tenant data isolation
Source citation generation linking responses to exact source passages
RAG evaluation pipelines measuring retrieval precision, recall, and groundedness

services.name: AI Workflow Automation & Controlled Agents
services.shortDescription: Multi-step operational workflows combining deterministic business logic with targeted AI assistance, backed by explicit permissions and human approvals.
services.fullDescription: Not every problem requires an autonomous agent, and allowing an AI agent broad, unconstrained authority over production systems is dangerous. We design predictable workflow automation that combines reliable deterministic business logic with targeted AI assistance for information parsing, synthesis, and drafting. Consequential actions always require explicit human authorization.
targetAudience: Operations teams handling repetitive multi-step customer or document workflows
Businesses looking to accelerate internal operations safely
businessProblem: Multi-step operational tasks (e.g. ticket intake, data extraction, draft preparation) causing bottlenecks.
Unconstrained "autonomous AI agents" taking unexpected, irreversible actions in production.
High labor costs spent copying data between internal business tools.
synezaSolution: Deterministic state machines that guide the workflow, invoking AI only where cognitive tasks are needed.
Strict human-in-the-loop review screens before any external communication, database write, or financial action.
Auditable execution logs capturing prompts, model outputs, and human approval timestamps.
Least-privilege API permissions that strictly prevent arbitrary file or shell execution.

Automated draft generation, classification, and summarization
Human-in-the-loop review and approval dashboards
Integration with existing operational software via secure REST APIs
Comprehensive audit logging of all AI reasoning steps and tool calls
Configurable fallback to manual queues when confidence thresholds are unmet

services.name: LLM Security & Responsible AI
services.shortDescription: Protect business AI implementations against prompt injection, unauthorized data disclosure, hallucination risks, and uncontrolled tool execution.
services.fullDescription: Connecting an LLM to internal business data introduces an entirely new threat surface. Our LLM security practice helps organizations implement defensive controls across the AI application lifecycle: input validation, prompt-injection defenses, strict tenant isolation, tool-calling restrictions, evaluation datasets, and audit logging. We treat security as an architectural requirement rather than a marketing slogan.
targetAudience: Enterprises deploying customer-facing or data-sensitive AI applications
Security and compliance teams reviewing internal AI deployments
businessProblem: Direct and indirect prompt injection attacks manipulating model behavior or attempting jailbreaks.
Sensitive customer PII or proprietary IP leaking through model responses or logs.
Unbounded agent tool calling executing destructive commands or accessing unauthorized databases.
Lack of systematic evaluation to measure whether new prompt revisions introduce regressions.
synezaSolution: Input sanitization, boundary demarcation, and defensive system prompt engineering.
Strict pre-retrieval authorization ensuring vector lookups respect user permission boundaries.
Tool-calling sandboxes with least-privilege permissions and mandatory human approval gates.
Curated evaluation benchmark datasets to measure accuracy, hallucination rates, and prompt resistance.
keyCapabilities: Prompt-injection threat modeling and defensive boundary engineering
Data minimization and automated PII masking before API transmission
Pre-retrieval access control and multi-tenant data isolation for RAG systems
Constrained tool-calling permissions and state-changing approval workflows
Evaluation dataset creation for regression testing of model outputs
Comprehensive audit logging with safe token redaction
